events.body:
## Context

`parse_yaml_frontmatter` in `generate_repo_list.py` (about L19-82) keeps quotes (`title: "OWASP Foo: Bar"` gives `'"OWASP Foo: Bar"'`), returns `[]` for block-list tags (`tags:` then `- a`), and treats `tags: builder breaker` as one tag. Titles, pitches and tags feed the dashboard's cards and search.

## What to do

1. Strip matching surrounding quotes from scalar values.
2. When `tags:` is empty, collect the following `- item` lines.
3. Keep it standard-library only; add `test/frontmatter.test.mjs` that shells out to python3 like `test/escaping.test.mjs`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Quoted title/pitch are unquoted
- [ ] Block-list tags parse
- [ ] Inline `[a, b]` and comma forms still work
- [ ] Test covers each case

## How to test locally

```bash
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-owasp-bumper
```
